name: jarlaxle baenre
lore:
Jarlaxle Baenre is a biological anomaly: a drow who has shed the suffocating gloom of the Underdark for the vibrant chaos of the surface. Unlike his kin, who recoil from the sun, Jarlaxle basks in it, draped in flamboyant silks and a feathered hat that marks him as a peacock among crows. He is an urban apex predator, thriving within the political thickets of Waterdeep and Luskan.

His behavior is a masterclass in theatrical deception. He moves with a rhythmic, jingling grace—a symphony of concealed magic and hidden steel. While he projects the air of a jovial rogue, his mind is a spiderweb of contingencies. He does not seek conquest through slaughter, but through leverage, charm, and sheer audacity. To encounter him is to be invited into a game where the rules are rewritten with every flourish of his purple cape.
